t: How the Knowledge Propagation Tracker works (Signature)
title: How the Knowledge Propagation Tracker works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Knowledge Propagation Tracker does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach builds the reuse graph deterministically: fixed text-reuse thresholds, fixed citation rules — the same corpus always yields the same propagation map. Each reuse edge carries its evidence ledger entry, and correction cascades are computed by fixed forward-traversal rules, producing an exact affected list. Update status per node (corrected/pending/unknown) is tracked in the cascade ledger. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
